Outline of LASER - 2000 Series: Products use optical scanning measurement method, non-contact measurement method to measure the objects of diameter, width and thickness, ovality. Products adopt dual axis measurement, measuring cycle material is high accuracy, easy to use. Product is suitable for wire, cable, pipes or rods on-line measurement and monitoring. Products are suitable for quality inspection and material classification. Measuring flat material can display the width and thickness simultaneously, suitable for flat cable, flat metal wire measurement etc. Instrument has external access interface can be accessed DPM series displayer and controller, PLC or computer. > **Image Description:** A photograph of the LASER 2000 Series Laser Scan Micrometer. It is a solid, dark-colored, U-shaped industrial measuring device. The inner angled edges of the "U" opening contain the optical scanning lenses. A small digital display panel with red LED digits is visible on the outer edge of the right-hand vertical arm. 2. Principle of Measurement The laser beam emitted from the semi-conductive laser "a" is deflected by the fast rotating octoangular prism "b" driven by the motor "c". After scanning and passing the lens "d", the beam becomes a beam of parallel light running through the measurement zone (gate). If the object to be measured "e" is located in the gate, it will block part of the parallel light. After the parallel light is transmitted through the focusing lens "f", the blocked part will be transformed into a low level electric signal while the unblocked part will be transformed into a high level electric signal by the photoelectric tube "g". The outer diameter of the tested object in the direction of the scanning light may be calculated from the scanning time of the low-level electric signal. > **Image Description:** A technical diagram illustrating the laser scanning measurement principle. On the left, a semi-conductive laser \[a\] emits a red beam toward a rotating octagonal prism \[b\] driven by a motor \[c\]. The beam reflects through a collimating lens \[d\], creating a wide, parallel band of red light running through a central measurement zone labeled "GATE". Within the GATE, a black, oval object being measured \[e\] blocks a portion of the parallel light. The remaining light passes through a focusing lens \[f\] on the right, converging into a photoelectric tube \[g\] at the far right end. 3. Features of LASER 2060: - High-Precision, good repeatability, the entire measurement zone are guaranteed accuracy. Completely non-contact, guide roller is un-necessary. - Adopt high-precision F (0) lens, object vibration is un-influence measurement. - Use laser scanning method and high-accuracy. Dual axis measurement is more accurate than the single axis. - Product is easy to use. - Measurement unit is compact design, adopt SMD circuit design, small size, weight is light. Anti-interference ability is good. - Instruments has RS485 communication interface, it can connect to DPM series displayer, PLC or computer on-line communication. - Measuring result is uninfluenced by impurity light and smog, measurement result is stability. - Instrument has alarm output interface to connect external alarm. - It has control signal output (it needs to configure DPM Series display controller). - Suitable for flat cable, flat metal wire measurement etc. Display the width and thickness simultaneously. 4.
